comment: Per-frame checks on the posed LOD0 meshes (mm, deg). skin = Body (closed mesh) signed distance, negative only within 3 cm of the surface; cloth = nearest Outfit vertex; leftupper / capsule values are relative measures (the idle pose itself gives about -15 / -23 mm where the arm meets the body); axis = ray from the rear (big) jaw tip back along the shank; wrist angles vs the forearm (ulnar +, extension +, pronation vs mid-prone, skin twist = the hand bone local twist).
